Agent Name: Baseball_Historian_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred in the very first step (Step 1) when the Baseball_Historian_Expert provided the initial solution. The agent incorrectly identified the player with the most walks as "Player_D" with 80 walks and 375 at bats. This was a hallucination or a retrieval error, as the correct player is Reggie Jackson with 86 walks and 512 at bats. This initial incorrect fact was the root cause of the problem, leading the subsequent Validation_Expert to have to correct the record and the DataAnalysis_Expert to attempt (and fail) to verify the wrong data via code.
